title: Smoked Herring Gratin
description: A traditional German-inspired dish with a twist, featuring smoked herring in a rich gratin.

ingredients.name: Welcoming cheese blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of cheddar, parmesan, and gouda

instructions: Slice the onion and separate into rings.
Crumb the Portuguese bread into small pieces and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix the welcoming cheese blend, eggs, and milk.
Grease a baking dish with butter.
Add a layer of sliced onion, followed by a layer of smoked herring.
Sprinkle crumbled bread over the herring, then pour the cheese mixture over.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
